about: Where each operational role the deployer holds belongs. A job's wallet is <JOB>_ADDRESS in env (credit-operator → CREDIT_OPERATOR_ADDRESS); "safe" is SAFE_ADDRESS; "renounce" is used by nothing off-chain. Mapped 2026-10-23 from apps/api and contracts/; see docs/command-reference/DECISIONS.md, "Moving the operational roles".
walletsAbout: Wallets known from the chain, used when env names none: the card settler is the one RevolvingIssuer approved (CardSettlerUpdated, block 46997232).

roles.why: audit H-4 (the plain OPERATOR passes no credit check now): openLine, updateCreditPeriod (extend only), openPlan on the member's signed terms, closePlanForRefund, OffersIssuer.grant (CREDIT_OPERATOR_PRIVATE_KEY)

audit H-4: setTermLimit and tier capacity (setTierCapacity), and reinstating a member who has not repaid in full; the LimitCalculator contract holds it too, for pushCapacities (CREDIT_OPERATOR_PRIVATE_KEY)

audit H-3: gasless deposits (to the depositor, or depositWithAuthorizationFor with a signed intent), redeemWithSignature and autopay mandates; no function accepts OPERATOR_ROLE now (savings relayer, CDP by default)
settling and refunding savings intents (savings relayer)
pledges and releases from the savings sync, which the savings relayer signs unless COLLATERAL_SIGNER_MODE=local_key

sends by link: the gasless lock (createTransferWithAuthorizationAndClaimKey) and claim to payout treasury; a wallet claim needs the claim key's signature and no role since audit H-4 (SEND_RELAYER_PRIVATE_KEY or its CDP account)
card funding borrows from the pool, only to the destination and within the daily cap the admin set with setBorrower (audit H-4, deploy/22: CARD_FLOAT_ADDRESS) (CARD_SETTLER_PRIVATE_KEY)
registering members and their status: the credit operator signs it (MEMBERSHIP_REGISTRAR_PRIVATE_KEY, else CREDIT_OPERATOR_PRIVATE_KEY)

top-ups: Command proposes these to the Safe
